test_title: PYST 2: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Benita: | had such a terrible fight with Samira last night.

I can't believe what | said. Richard: | don’t need to hear all about it. Some things are better left unsaid.

What does Richard mean when he says, "Some things are better left unsaid"?

options.text: Some things should remain private and not be spoken about.
Everything should always be openly discussed.
Speaking about problems will always make them worse.
It's best to forget everything after a fight.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Richard suggests that it might not always be necessary or appropriate to talk about every detail of a personal conflict.
 
• By implying that some things are better left unsaid, he indicates a preference for keeping certain matters private.
 
• The context shows Richard's intention to avoid discussing potentially sensitive or hurtful issues.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: Everything should always be openly discussed** – This option is incorrect because Richard did not suggest that all matters should be openly discussed.
 
• **Option 3: Speaking about problems will always make them worse** – This option is incorrect as Richard did not imply that discussing problems will always have a negative outcome.
 
• **Option 4: It's best to forget everything after a fight** – This option is incorrect because Richard's comment was about keeping certain things private, not necessarily about forgetting the fight.
